summary: Iteration 8: Phase 2 (Real POS Import) + Table Tent PDF end-to-end validated. Backend suite expanded 48 -> 56 tests. New TestPhase2POSImport (5 tests) + TestTableTentPDF (3 tests) — all pass in 1.02s. Full regression: 56/56 pytest tests PASSED in 30.87s (includes TestVideoCritic full pipeline). Phase 2 backend verified: GET /api/executioner/sample-transactions-csv returns Square-style headers (Date,Net Sales,Customer ID,Postal Code,Clicks,Discount) with 28 rows; POST /api/executioner/import-transactions {csv,source:'square'} imports 28 orders/$763.52 across 2 weeks, mapping shows discount->promo_code, net_sales->net sales, etc.; after import reports contains real weeks with dataSource='real'+txCount>0 while all 3 demo baseline weeks preserve dataSource='demo'. Generic CSV `promo_code,net_sales,customer_id,postal_code,clicks,date` imports 1 row with correct column mapping. CSV with no amount column returns HTTP 422 as designed. POST /api/executioner/clear-transactions restores exactly 3 demo baseline weeks. Table Tent: GET /api/maximizer/table-tent.pdf?spaceId=Table%20Tent&base=https://demo.app returns 200 with content-type=application/pdf, 5429 bytes, %PDF-1.3 magic header; also works with no params and strips base without scheme. Frontend flow (Executioner, 1920x1080, light theme): initial data-source-badge='DEMO DATA' -> click load-sample-tx-btn (textarea filled with 1330 chars) -> click import-tx-btn -> import-result 'Imported 28 orders ($763.52) across 2 week(s). Mapped columns: promo_code->discount, net_sales->net sales, customer_id->customer id, postal_code->postal code, clicks->clicks, date->date.' + success toast; badge flipped to '● LIVE ORDER DATA'; clear-tx-btn appeared; clicking it -> toast 'Real orders cleared — back to the demo baseline' + badge back to 'DEMO DATA'. Maximizer QR generator: click generate-qr-btn -> qr-image renders + download-tent-btn present with href=/api/maximizer/table-tent.pdf?spaceId=Table%20Tent&base=<origin>. Nav across nav-overview/executioner/maximizer/content all clean with 0 console errors. Final state: DB cleared of real transactions, reports=3 demo weeks, connections default.
action_items: OPTIONAL: _parse_transactions_csv uses naive line.split(',') — CSVs with commas inside quoted fields (e.g. addresses, item names) will misalign columns. Consider using the stdlib csv module.

OPTIONAL: /api/maximizer/table-tent.pdf has no rate limiting; each call spawns tempfile + FPDF + segno QR (~50ms) and creates/removes a temp dir. Cache by (spaceId, base, brand-hash, active-game) or move to on-demand pre-signed URL.

OPTIONAL: table_tent_pdf's `base` sanitation only checks http/https prefix — a base like 'https://evil.com' still passes through and the QR would direct scans to attacker origin. Same concern flagged in iter 7 for /spin/qr; consider gating to deployment origin.

OPTIONAL: rebuild_reports resets share_a to reports[-1]['allocation']['strategyA']['share'] (i.e. the last demo baseline week's share) before iterating real weeks — this means real-week learning always continues from where demo left off. Fine, but worth documenting.
OPTIONAL: server.py is now ~1952 lines — long overdue to split into routers/services (previously flagged).
critical_code_review_comments: _parse_transactions_csv splits on comma naively — any CSV with quoted commas will corrupt the row. FPDF-generated PDFs will pass, but real Square exports occasionally quote-escape address fields. Use csv.reader.

TX_ALIASES parses money via _parse_money which strips $ and commas. Multi-currency inputs (e.g. '€24.50', 'CA$24.50') are ignored gracefully but silently skipped — worth surfacing to the user beyond 'skipped' count.
import_transactions insert_many wraps each doc in dict() — but docs already came from list of dicts, so this is a no-op. Minor code smell.

table_tent_pdf constructs tempfile.mkdtemp then writes QR PNG and reads it into FPDF — could be avoided by using an in-memory BytesIO with segno.save(buf, kind='png') and pdf.image(BytesIO(...)) once FPDF supports it (fpdf2 does). Reduces I/O.
rebuild_reports awaits db.transactions.distinct then a find() per week — for a tenant with many weeks this becomes O(N) round trips. Consider a single aggregation pipeline grouping by weekOf.

The 'skipped' counter in import_transactions is returned but never surfaced in the toast — user only sees imported count. If a batch has 100 rows and 40 skip silently, they'd never know why revenue looks low.
seed_data_creation: TestPhase2POSImport imported 28 sample Square transactions and then cleared them via /api/executioner/clear-transactions in the teardown test; final DB state has 0 real transactions and 3 demo baseline weeks. Frontend UI test also imported+cleared. TestScanToSpinPhase3 added ~6 rows to db.redemptions (unchanged from iter 7). Connections/brand/calendar defaults preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0` runs 56 tests (~31s). TestPhase2POSImport tests must execute in class order (test_clear_transactions_restores_demo_baseline is the teardown that leaves DB in a clean state). If you re-run just a subset like TestPhase2POSImport::test_import_square_csv_recomputes_reports without the clear test, transactions will remain in DB and executioner/reports will show 4-5 reports. Always call POST /api/executioner/clear-transactions at the end. Frontend testids added in Phase 2: import-transactions, tx-csv-input, load-sample-tx-btn, import-tx-btn, clear-tx-btn, import-result, data-source-badge. Maximizer added: download-tent-btn (link, not button) with href to /api/maximizer/table-tent.pdf. tableTentUrl() in api.js constructs the URL client-side from spaceId+window.location.origin. The Executioner UI reads latest.dataSource to switch the badge — so the badge reflects only the MOST RECENT week (which may be demo if all real weeks are older).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Phase 2 pipeline is coherent end-to-end: (1) CSV parser handles Square headers, generic headers, and rejects amount-less CSVs with 422; (2) import writes docs into db.transactions with weekOf keys, then rebuild_reports rebuilds full history = 3 demo baseline + N real weeks labeled dataSource; (3) overview totals grow proportionally; (4) clear-transactions deletes all real docs and rebuilds back to exactly 3 demo weeks; (5) Frontend badge, import-result summary, and clear button all correctly gate on importRes state; (6) Table Tent PDF is a real ~5.4KB fpdf2-generated PDF (verified %PDF-1.3 magic + application/pdf content-type) with segno QR embedded pointing to /spin?space=<spaceId>.
